notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary + Performance Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🎉 [b]Aestik’s 1 Year Anniversary![/b] 🎉[/h1][p]Today we celebrate [b]one year of Aestik[/b] — thank you all SO much for joining us on this journey. 💜
It’s been an absolute blast, and we couldn’t have done it without your support![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/1682c68f6172946e89868d7ee98ca252be7c63d7.png"][/img][/p][p]To mark the occasion, we’re rolling out a special update:
✨ Improved game performance → the game should now run [b]smoother than ever[/b]![/p][p]Thanks again for being part of our adventure - we appreciate you! 🥂


Also, feel free to check out our [b]new upcoming game[/b] 💜

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399930/Roulette_Dungeon/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Aestik's [b]new patch[/b] just dropped - Addressing the most commonly requested features! 🤍

[*] 📍 Added [b]player position on the map[/b]: The map now shows the accurate player position on the map! (1.3)

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/75a4330db3d4e3dd8f5c157b6c1e33297eb370dd.png[/img]


[b][h3]🍃 New Ability System + Quality of Life Additions & More! 🍃[/h3][/b]

Hi folks (:

We're thrilled to announce that we've just updated the demo once again!

We made a lot of "quality of life" additions & changes to improve your experience with Aestik.

As always, please [url=https://discord.com/invite/vpfhKvuCFw]feel free to join the official Aestik Discord[/url] to let us know what you think (...or to report any bugs you encountered). 🌱


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/128ed686b9fc0451841bdce0d2a463c41be0b4ab.png[/img]


[h3]Here are the most important changes & additions:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Rune System[/b] - [b]Abilities [/b]in Aestik can now be [b]equipped and un-equipped[/b] as you please + we've added rune descriptions! (see screenshot above)

[*] [b]Map System[/b] - The map now highlights the room you're currently in!

[*] [b]Improved Player Controls[/b] - You can now [b]look up/down[/b] by holding the respective button while standing still!

[*] [b]Visual Improvements[/b] - for example 🍂 [b]tiny falling leaves[/b] 🍃 in the Bubblewoods that give the Realm of Aestik even more life and atmosphere! (:

[*] Balancing Adjustments

[*] Bug Fixes
[/list]

Anyway, it's getting late - DON'T FORGET TO [b]WISHLIST AESTIK[/b] AND SHARE IT WITH ALL YOUR FRIENDS, FAMILY MEMBERS, PETS AND PLANTS! 🤍⚔️

Much love,
Julia & Nic


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43550964/41c057707adab2f0452cf6d93a653359ff6e1e52.png[/img]
